summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Round 4 UI/content changes for Bretton J. Key portfolio site. All features tested and verified working correctly on both desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844) viewports.
passed_tests: Skip Intro button navigates directly to Services section ('How I Can Help'), not Introduction
Values room: All 4 value nodes (Faith, Connection, Service, Growth) display updated descriptions with NO old 'Community' or 'Simplicity' text
Values room: Highlight cards show white background with black readable text
Projects carousel: Exactly 7 slides present (Date Jar, KeyTech Solutions, New Venture 01-05 with 'Concept' status)
Projects carousel: All slides have white card backgrounds and dark text, navigation arrows and dots work correctly
Media & Impact: Counter animates from 0 to '30+' on scroll into view
Media & Impact: Exactly 3 category tiles present (Features: 11 placements, Podcasts: 4 placements, TV & Video Appearances: 7 placements)
Media & Impact: Tiles show glossy black gradient on hover and when active
Media & Impact: Clicking a tile makes it active (glossy black) and reveals/updates carousel below
Media & Impact carousel: Shows real content with title, source/date (e.g., 'VIRGINIA BUSINESS · JUN 2025'), description, and 'View Full Story' link
Media & Impact carousel: 'View Full Story' links open in new tab (target='_blank', rel='noopener noreferrer')
Media & Impact carousel: Auto-advances every ~4 seconds and pauses on hover
Media & Impact carousel: Prev/next arrow buttons on both edges work correctly
Media & Impact carousel: Podcasts and TV & Video categories show embedded video players (YouTube iframes) for applicable items
All 3 category tiles switch carousel content correctly when clicked
Mobile (390x844): All features work correctly including Skip Intro, Values interaction, Projects carousel (7 slides), and Media & Impact room with counter, tiles, and carousel
General regression: Organizations logos marquee, Voices and Impact carousel, Services cards, Gallery carousel, Thoughts section, and Contact form all working correctly from prior rounds
